info.name: Anvis Management API
info.description: Complete Postman API Collection for Anvis Management System including Authentication, Users, Roles, Permissions, Branches, Departments, Vendors, RO Forms, Accounts, Dashboard, Domains, Payments, and Purchase Invoices.

request.description: Get unified dashboard statistics combining both RO Management and Domain Management. Admin and Superadmin see all data across all departments and branches. Managers and Employees see department-wise statistics. Supports optional date filters and admin department/branch filtering.

item.name: Get Revenue Summary (Admin, Superadmin & Accounts Only)

request.description: Approve an RO Form by assigned manager (primary/secondary lead) or Admin. If ANY one manager approves, the status immediately becomes 'approved'. approved_by tracks the count (0 = no one, 1 = one manager approved, 2 = both managers approved). Duplicate approval by the same user is rejected with 422.
